purpose: Teach: 吹か/絵柄/被る/亡き/女将/桶/安物/小豆

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「春風を吹かれた窓辺で本を読みたい」って仰ってたわ
lines.en: Sho, Dad was saying he'd love to read by the window with the spring breeze on him.
lines.style: Soft dreamy relay of the quote, unhurried, a fond breath before spring breeze.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんと「絵柄が綺麗な着物」を選んだよ
lines.en: Mom, me and Dad picked out a kimono with a really pretty pattern!
lines.style: Pleased little report, careful respect on kimono, brightening fully by the end.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「雨に被るから、傘を持って」って仰ったわ
lines.en: Dad said to take an umbrella so you don't get caught in the rain.
lines.style: Gentle firm mother-voice, the reminder delivered kindly, slight emphasis landing on umbrella.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんと「亡き祖父のお話」を聞いたよ
lines.en: Dad told me stories about Grandpa… the grandpa who isn't here anymore.
lines.style: Quiet and careful, slowing at the mention of Grandpa, small solemn pause before finishing.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「旅館の女将さんが優しい」って仰ってたわ
lines.en: Dad was saying how kind the innkeeper lady at the ryokan was.
lines.style: Warm easy recollection, a grateful softness on kind, pace comfortable and settled.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんと「お風呂の桶でひっくり返した」失敗したよ
lines.en: Me and Dad knocked the bath bucket right over… it went everywhere!
lines.style: Sheepish giggle breaking through the confession, rushing the spill, ending in delighted embarrassment.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「安物のおもちゃでも工夫すれば長く遊べる」って仰ってたわ
lines.en: Dad says even a cheap toy can last ages if you get creative with it.
lines.style: Approving practical warmth, slight teacherly slowing on the lesson, softened with a smile.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんと小豆を入れたあんぱんを食べたよ
lines.en: And me and Dad ate sweet buns with red beans inside!
lines.style: Happy full-cheeks energy, savoring red beans, tiny satisfied sigh closing it out.
